user.title: Choose a sign-in method
user.description: Automatic sign-in is recommended. Browser sign-in is also available if MyQ blocks the automatic flow.

credentials.title: Connect MyQ
credentials.description: Enter the credentials for your MyQ account.

browser_start.title: Sign in with a browser
browser_start.description: Enter the email address for your MyQ account. Your password and verification code will be entered only on the MyQ website.

mfa.title: Verification code
mfa.description: Enter the six-digit verification code you received.

reauth_mfa.title: Verification code
reauth_mfa.description: Enter the six-digit verification code you received.

browser.title: Sign in with a browser
browser.description: [Open MyQ sign-in]({authorization_url}) in a browser and sign in with {email}. When the browser tries to open `com.myqops://android`, copy the complete callback address and paste it below. If no address appears, press F12, open the browser console, find the `Failed to launch 'com.myqops://android?...'` message, and copy the complete address from it. The link expires in 10 minutes.

migrate.title: Transfer an existing authorization
migrate.description: Advanced migration: stop the client that owns this refresh token before transferring it. Home Assistant will validate and take over the authorization. Do not reuse this token in another client. Normal browser sign-in remains available for reauthentication.

data.previous_client_stopped: The previous owner of this token has been stopped

error.authentication_expired: The sign-in session expired. Start again.
error.browser_auth_failed: MyQ rejected the browser authorization. Open the new sign-in link and try again.
error.browser_session_expired: The browser sign-in session expired. Open the new sign-in link and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The email address or password is incorrect.
error.invalid_callback: The callback address is invalid or belongs to a different sign-in attempt.
error.invalid_mfa: The verification code is invalid or expired.
error.unknown: Unexpected MyQ error. Check the logs for details.
error.migration_owner_active: Stop the previous token owner before transferring authorization.
error.migration_failed: Could not validate this authorization. Use browser sign-in or a fresh token from the stopped client.

abort.already_configured: This MyQ account is already configured. No additional setup is needed.
abort.cannot_connect: Authentication succeeded, but MyQ device discovery could not be reached.
abort.no_devices: No supported garage doors or Video Keypads were found on this account.

camera_image_failed.message: The MyQ camera snapshot could not be retrieved.

init.title: Keypad recording settings
init.description: LAN only never relays video through the cloud. LAN preferred allows cloud relay if LAN startup fails. Cloud relay explicitly uses cloud video. Cloud login and wake-up are required in all modes. Changing transport closes active sessions. Only recordings created after managed retention was enabled are eligible for deletion. Existing clips are preserved. Retention 0 keeps managed clips indefinitely. Longer recordings and frequent triggers use more battery.

data.retention_days: Delete managed clips after (days; 0 disables deletion)
